systems.system: Fundo de Apoio ao Desenvolvimento das Comunicações (FADCOM)

note: Minister says Angola Digital (180 free access points, 18 provinces) is promoted by FADCOM with partners on 2026-09-16; no amount, no payer, no law assigning the fund to digital programmes, so no acted fact. Conecta, Angola Online and the fibre network are named with no financing.
